data.one_liner: Flutter gradient wrappers that interpolate colors in the HCT color system.
data.what_it_does: Provides enhanced versions of LinearGradient, RadialGradient, and SweepGradient that interpolate colors using the HCT color system rather than standard RGB. It also includes an HctColorTween for color transitions in Flutter animations.
use_when: You want smoother or more perceptually accurate color transitions in gradients.
You are already using Material color utilities and want HCT-based animations or tweens.
avoid_when: You require standard RGB or HSL color interpolation for specific design guidelines.
You are using a Flutter version older than 3.27.0.
strengths: Easy to use via wrapper classes or extension methods.
Includes a custom HctColorTween for animations.
weaknesses: HCT results are subjective and might not always look better than regular gradients depending on the effect.
Requires a relatively recent minimum Flutter version (3.27.0).
